kjv: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.

lines.say: Been holding it all together by yourself? Hear this tonight.
lines.big: Been holding it all together by yourself

lines.say: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it:
lines.big: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it:

lines.say: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain. Psalm one twenty seven, verse one.
lines.big: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.

lines.say: You can stop guarding everything. Let him keep watch tonight.
lines.big: You can stop guarding everything. Let him keep watch tonight.

lines.say: Lord, build my house and keep watch over it tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.
Want the Word playing while you sleep? Psalms 125 through 150, read slowly, is on our channel. The link is in the description.
